ai_deductions.tag_zh: 全球流动性与利率定价
ai_deductions.event_zh: 美债10年期收益率维持在4.15%上方，同时WTI原油价格回落至70美元区间。
ai_deductions.event_en: US 10Y Treasury yield holds above 4.15% while WTI Crude pulls back to the $70 range.
ai_deductions.logic_zh: 油价温和压制二次通胀预期 → 美联储与加拿大央行维持渐进降息路径 → 长端无风险利率缺乏大幅上行动力，高股息与价值板块折现率压力缓解。
ai_deductions.logic_en: Soft oil prices cap re-inflation fears → Fed & BoC stay on gradual rate-cut path → Long-end yields lack upward momentum, easing discount rate pressure on dividend & value assets.
ai_deductions.outcome_zh: 大概率利好：美加高股息ETF（SCHD/VDY.TO）与短久期美债；高估值纯成长科技股维持震荡。
ai_deductions.outcome_en: Likely Beneficiary: US/CA High-Dividend ETFs (SCHD/VDY.TO) & short-duration bonds; high-multiple tech remains range-bound.
ai_deductions.raw_data_zh: 底层指标：US 10Y = 4.18% | US 2Y = 3.96% | WTI = $70.4 | 金油比 = 38.6（高于30历史均值，提示避险需求仍在）。
ai_deductions.raw_data_en: Underlying Metrics: US 10Y = 4.18% | US 2Y = 3.96% | WTI = $70.4 | Gold/Oil Ratio = 38.6 (Above 30 historical avg, signaling persistent hedging demand).

ai_deductions.tag_zh: 中国资产与港股离岸流动性
ai_deductions.event_zh: 沪深300风险溢价（ERP）处于历史80%以上高分位，南向资金连续净流入港股高息央企。
ai_deductions.event_en: CSI 300 Equity Risk Premium (ERP) sits above the 80th historical percentile, with steady Southbound inflows into HK high-yield SOEs.
ai_deductions.logic_zh: 国内10年期国债收益率处于低位（约2.1%）→ 股息率超5%的红利资产对长线险资构成显著吸引力 → 底部安全边际极高。
ai_deductions.logic_en: China 10Y bond yield remains low (~2.1%) → Dividend assets yielding >5% offer compelling spread for long-term institutional capital → Strong downside floor.
ai_deductions.outcome_zh: 大概率走势：A股红利低波ETF与港股高息电讯/能源股具备强防御性，适合逢低定投累积份额。
ai_deductions.outcome_en: Likely Trend: A-Share Low-Vol Dividend ETFs and HK high-yield telecom/energy stocks provide strong defense; ideal for dip accumulation.
ai_deductions.raw_data_zh: 底层指标：沪深300 PE = 12.1x | 10年中债 = 2.12% | 隐含ERP = 6.14% | 恒生AH溢价指数 = 142.5。
ai_deductions.raw_data_en: Underlying Metrics: CSI 300 PE = 12.1x | CN 10Y Yield = 2.12% | Implied ERP = 6.14% | Hang Seng AH Premium = 142.5.
